monday.label: Push (Chest / Shoulders / Triceps)
monday.warmup: Treadmill incline walk 5 min easy + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2 + DB front raise 5 lbs × 10. If the walk feels like effort, see the stop rules
monday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min before standing still + doorway pec stretch 60s ea side + cross-body shoulder stretch 60s ea side + overhead triceps stretch 60s ea side. 16 oz electrolyte water. No thermocycling today

exercises.notes: Last 60 ea 12/11/7 on 8/30. 75% → 45. Clean full-depth pattern, 3 in reserve; stop at 10 even if it feels easy
Last 60 ea 12/10/9 on 8/30. 75% → 45. No spotter: rack the DBs before anything grinds. Sit up slowly
Last 30 10/9/9 on 8/30. 22.5 → 20. Controlled stretch; no lengthened partials this week
Last 50 ea 10×3 on 8/30 (55 banked from 9/2, stays banked). 37.5 → 35. First overhead work since the fever: any light-headedness, stop and lie down per the stop rules
Last 20 ea 10×3 on 8/30. 75% = 15. Strict, no swing; rehearse the path, not the burn
Last 40 12/12/10 on 8/30. 75% = 30. Elbows pinned; 10 not 12
Last 55 12/11/12 on 8/30. 41.25 → 40. Seated with back support; 10 not 12. Skip it if slot 4 produced any light-headedness, even if it cleared

tuesday.label: Pull (Back / Biceps / Rear Delts)
tuesday.warmup: Rower 5 min easy + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2 + scap pull-ups × 10. Same warm-up check as Monday
tuesday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + child's pose with side reach 60s ea side + cross-body rear-delt stretch 60s ea side + gentle forearm stretch 45s ea side. 16 oz electrolyte water. No thermocycling today

exercises.notes: Last 130 10×3 on 8/31. 97.5 → 95. Chest up, full stretch at the top, no lean-back
Last 130 12×3 on 8/31 (135 banked, stays banked). 97.5 → 95. Pause at the chest; 10 not 12
Last 65 ea 12×3 on 8/31 (70 banked). 48.75 → 45. LEFT first; right matches left's reps; no torso heave
Last 60 15×3 on 8/31 (65 banked). 75% = 45. Rope to the ears, strict; 12 not 15
Last 20 ea 15×3 on 8/31 (25 banked). 75% = 15. Strict, soft elbows, no swing; 12 not 15
Last 60 10×3 on 8/31. 45 → 40 (PF fixed bars step by 10; take 45 only if the rack has one). No hip swing
Last 30 ea 10×3 on 8/31. 22.5 → 20 (no 22s exist). Controlled, elbows still
Last 75 ea 25s×3 on 8/31. 56.25 → 55; 20 s each side, LEFT hand first. Tall, no lean, keep breathing the whole walk

wednesday.label: Legs (Quads / Hams / Glutes / Calves / Core)
wednesday.warmup: Easy treadmill 5–8 min + controlled bodyweight squats × 10 + glute bridges × 10 + one light ramp-up set each on squat and leg press. Pain rule: keep left groin/adductor discomfort at 0–2/10; stop or modify anything sharp, worsening, or movement-changing
wednesday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + gentle standing quad stretch 45s ea side + gentle hamstring stretch 45s ea side + calf stretch 45s ea side. No wide-stance or aggressive adductor stretching. 16 oz electrolyte water. No thermocycling today

exercises.notes: Last 140 10×3 on 9/1 (hip-protective). 75% = 105; 8 not 10, this is the DOMS trap. Pain-free depth; light brace, exhale on the drive, no held breath

Last 270/320/320 × 10/10/11 on 9/1 (app history shows 270×3; sets 2–3 were 320 per the log note). 75% of 320 = 240 (45+45+25+5 per side). Feet hip-width; do not bottom out; exhale on the push, no held breath
Last 120 10/10/9 on 9/1. 75% = 90; 8 not 10, hamstring DOMS is the day-3 risk. Controlled eccentric, double-overhand; stand up slowly
Last 85 12/12/10 on 9/1. 63.75 → 60. Full range, pause at the bottom
Last 110 10/10/9 on 9/1. 82.5 → 80. Full lockout only if the hip stays quiet; chin tucked. Sit up for 20–30 s before standing
Last 260 15/15/14 on 9/1. 75% = 195; 12 not 15, calves are the other post-layoff DOMS site. Full range, 1 s pause, no bounce
Last 60 10×3 on 9/1 (W36 target was 12). 75% = 45. Controlled flexion; exhale into the crunch
Last 25-lb plate 12×3 on 9/1. 18.75 → 15 would mean two plates on your chest; take the single 10-lb plate (25 returns in W41 when the hinge feels normal). Smooth, no hyperextension; come up slowly

thursday.label: Upper Hybrid (Shoulders / Chest / Back / Arms / Core)
thursday.warmup: Rower 5 min easy + scap circles + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2. Same warm-up check as Monday
thursday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + doorway pec stretch 60s ea side + child's pose with side reach 60s ea side + cross-body shoulder stretch 60s ea side. 16 oz electrolyte water. Thermocycling only if Mon–Wed were flag-free: ONE round, 10 min sauna + 90 s–2 min plunge (and then none on Friday)

exercises.notes: Last 50 ea 12×3 on 9/2 (55 banked, stays banked). 37.5 → 35. Same 35s as Monday; strict, 10 not 12
Last 55 ea 11/12/11 on 9/2. 41.25 → 40. Second incline exposure this week; stay at 3 in reserve
Last 15 ea 16/15/15 on 9/2. 11.25 → 10. Strict, no swing; 12 not 15
Last 60 15×3 on 9/2 (65 banked). 75% = 45. Same as Tuesday; rope to the ears
Last 60 ea 10×3 on 9/2. 75% = 45. LEFT first; right matches left's reps
Last 35 9/9/7 on 9/2. 26.25 → 25; 8 reps, elbows still, no bounce at the bottom. Sit up slowly
Last 50 10×3 on 9/2. 37.5 → 35. LEFT side first; exhale on the press-out, no twist
Last 60s×3 on 9/2. 40 s each side, LEFT first. Level hips; keep breathing, isometrics invite breath-holds

friday.label: Lower Hybrid (Glutes / Quads / Hams / Calves / Core)
friday.warmup: Easy bike or treadmill 5–8 min + controlled bodyweight squats × 10 + glute bridges × 10 + gentle reverse lunges only if pain-free + one light ramp-up set on the single-leg press (50 lbs × 6 each leg, left first). No wide hip openers
friday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + gentle quad, hamstring, and calf stretches 45s ea side. No wide-leg, straddle, 90/90, figure-4, or other position that reproduces the inner-thigh pull. 16 oz electrolyte water. Thermocycling only if you did NOT go Thursday and Mon–Fri, including today's session, were flag-free: ONE round, 10 min sauna + 90 s–2 min plunge

exercises.notes: Last 115 12×3 on 9/4. 86.25 → 85; 10 not 12. LEFT first; right matches left's reps; pain-free depth, not a strength test
Last 25 ea 15×3 on 9/4 (30 banked). 18.75 → 15; 10 per leg, not 15 — lunges are the DOMS trap after a layoff. LEFT leg steps first; hip-width tracks
Last 75 15×3 on 9/4 (80 banked). 56.25 → 55; 12 not 15. Full range, pause at the bottom
Last 90 15×3 on 9/4 (held protective). 67.5 → 65; 12 not 15. Symptom-free middle range, controlled
Last 65 15/15/12 on 8/9; out W35–W39 for the left groin. ~60% probe, pads set narrow, middle range only. Only if the gate above passed; 0–2/10 or stop
Last 50 ea 13/12/12 on 9/4. 37.5 → 35. LEFT first; right matches; full range, 1 s pause
Last 55 15/12/12 on 9/4. 41.25 → 40. Controlled; exhale into the crunch
Last 25-lb plate 15/12/12 on 9/4. 18.75 → 15 would mean two plates; take the same single 10-lb plate as Wednesday. Smooth; come up slowly
